== Biography ==
William was born about 1818. 
<ref>Estimated from death 
</ref>

In 1901 William McCaw 80, born Co Londonderry, was living with his daughter and family. Isaac Stevenson 43, biscuit Manufactorer, his wife Florence 36, born Manchester, England, and their children all born Londonderry, Maurice McCaw 11, Irene Constance 8 , Leonard William Hugh 4, Florence Evelyn and 4 servants. <ref> https://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1901/Londonderry/Waterside/Victoria_Park/1540882/ </ref> 

In 1861 William 39 from Ireland, a Presbyterian Minister, was living with his wife Sarah 39 from Ireland, and a daughter Mary aged 13, born Manchester in Smedley Lane, Cheetham Hill, Manchester. <ref> "England and Wales Census, 1861", , FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:M7NZ-H8P : Sat Mar 09 18:45:41 UTC 2024), Entry for William McCaw and Sarah McCaw, 1861. </ref> 

William McCaw, widower of Victoria Park, Waterside aged 84, a retired minister died in 1902.Margaret Ferguson of 14 Marlborough Terrace, Londonderry, registered the death. <ref>Londonderry SR District https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/images/deaths_returns/deaths_1902/05679/4600144.pdf </ref> 
: REV DR. MCCAW.
:The Rev Dr. McCaw formerly Clerk and twice Moderator of the Synod of the English Presbyterian Church, was buried at Londonderry yesterday. The Rev W. M. McPhail, Senior Clerk of the English Synod, conducted the service, and an address was delivered by the Moderator of the General Assembly of the Irish Presbyterian Charch. Representatives of deceased's former church at Manchester attended. <ref> Published: Saturday 03 January 1903 
Newspaper: Daily News (London)  page 3 https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0000051/19030103/061/0003 </ref> 

He is buried in Derry City Cemetery, age on headstone 81. <ref>{{FindAGrave| 249336828}}</ref>

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns William Macaw. A fresh audit of the surviving Rasharkin Presbyterian baptism transcription located a second parent-bearing McCaughern/Macaw household at the target townland. Hugh Macaw was born 3 February 1839 and baptised 3 March 1839 as the son of William and Mary Kilpatrick, resident at Lisnagaver (entry 125).<ref>Rasharkin Presbyterian baptisms, entries 125 and 204; [https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/RasharkinP/Baptisms_1834.html record].</ref> The same register records Jane Matilda Macaw, born 26 July 1843 and baptised 14 January 1844, as the daughter of William and Mary Kilpatrick at Granagh (entry 204). Named transcription reread 30 September 2026; originalmanuscriptuninspected. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns William Macaw. Rasharkin baptism transcription entry 125 gives Hugh Macaw’s birth as 3 February 1839 and his baptism as 3 March 1839. Another transcription gave 5 February for the birth; the original manuscript is required to settle the difference.<ref>Rasharkin Presbyterian baptism transcription; [https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/RasharkinP/Baptisms_1834.html record].</ref> Named transcription reread; original manuscript uninspected. The identification remains uncertain.
